texts.title: U8 · pág 86 - 87
texts.body: At home and in my shop I usually wear sweatpants and a T-shirt, because they are comfortable and I move a lot at work. But for a party at a friend's home I don't wear them, so I put on a shirt and jeans. In Bogotá the weather is cold, so I also wear a sweater over my shirt almost every day. For example, I take a light coat when it rains in the morning. When I shop for clothes, three things are important to me. First, the price, because I don't want to spend a lot of money. Then the selection, since I like to compare many things before I decide. Finally, the service, because I have a shop too and I know that good service brings people back. So my favorite store is the one with the lowest prices, the biggest selection and the best service.
texts.trans: En la casa y en mi local normalmente uso sudadera y camiseta, porque son cómodas y me muevo mucho trabajando. Pero para una fiesta en casa de un amigo no las uso, así que me pongo una camisa y jean. En Bogotá el clima es frío, así que también uso un saco sobre la camisa casi todos los días. Por ejemplo, llevo una chaqueta liviana cuando llueve en la mañana. Cuando compro ropa, tres cosas me importan. Primero, el precio, porque no quiero gastar mucha plata. Luego la variedad, ya que me gusta comparar muchas cosas antes de decidir. Finalmente, la atención, porque yo también tengo un negocio y sé que la buena atención hace que la gente vuelva. Así que mi tienda favorita es la que tiene los precios más bajos, la mayor variedad y la mejor atención.

wh.q: What do you usually wear at home?
wh.a: I usually wear sweatpants and a T-shirt at home and in my shop. They are comfortable, and I move a lot at work. But I don't wear them to a party, so I put on a shirt and jeans.

wh.q: What is important to you when you shop for clothes?
wh.a: All three are important to me. First, the price, because I don't want to spend a lot of money. Then the selection and the service, since I like to compare before I decide.

wh.q: Why is service important to you?
wh.a: Service is important because I have a shop too. I know that good service brings people back, so I look for it. For example, I always go back to the small shops near my house.

wh.q: What do you wear when it's cool in Bogotá?
wh.a: The weather in Bogotá is cold, so I wear a sweater over my shirt almost every day. I also take a light coat when it rains in the morning. But I don't need a heavy jacket, because it isn't very cold.

texts.title: U8 · pág 88 - 89
texts.body: My favorite clothes are running shoes and T-shirts. I like them because they are very comfortable, and I usually wear them in my shop. But I don't wear them to a party, so for a party I put on a polo shirt and jeans. In Bogotá the weather is cold, so I also need a sweater. My favorite one is a crewneck, and my mother gave it to me last year. For example, I wear it when I open the shop in the morning, because it's very cold at that hour. Then last December I bought a nice purse for my mother. I saw it in a small shop near my house, and it was on sale, so I took it. She liked it a lot, and she still uses it. Finally, I don't buy many clothes, but when I buy them I want good prices and good service.
texts.trans: Mi ropa favorita son los tenis y las camisetas. Me gustan porque son muy cómodos, y normalmente los uso en mi local. Pero no me los pongo para una fiesta, así que para una fiesta me pongo un polo y jean. En Bogotá el clima es frío, así que también necesito un saco. Mi favorito es uno de cuello redondo, y mi mamá me lo regaló el año pasado. Por ejemplo, me lo pongo cuando abro el local en la mañana, porque hace mucho frío a esa hora. Luego, en diciembre pasado le compré un bolso bonito a mi mamá. Lo vi en una tienda pequeña cerca de mi casa, y estaba en promoción, así que lo llevé. A ella le gustó mucho, y todavía lo usa. Finalmente, no compro mucha ropa, pero cuando la compro quiero buenos precios y buena atención.

wh.q: What are your favorite clothes?
wh.a: My favorite clothes are running shoes and T-shirts. I like them because they are very comfortable, and I usually wear them in my shop. But I don't wear them to a party.

wh.q: Who gave you your favorite sweater?
wh.a: My mother gave it to me last year. It's a crewneck, and I wear it when I open the shop in the morning. I like it because it's very cold at that hour in Bogotá.

wh.q: What did you buy for your mother?
wh.a: I bought a nice purse for her last December. I saw it in a small shop near my house, and it was on sale, so I took it. She liked it a lot, and she still uses it.

wh.q: What do you wear to a party?
wh.a: I don't wear running shoes to a party. I put on a polo shirt and jeans, because they look better. But at home and in my shop I always wear something comfortable.

texts.title: U8 · pág 90 - 91
texts.body: When a friend asks me where to buy clothes, I always say: that depends. First, what are you looking for? Because the answer is different for shoes and for a jacket. For example, if you want cheap clothes, the small shops near my house have the lowest prices in my neighborhood. But they don't have the biggest selection, so sometimes you can't find your size. Then there is the mall. It has the newest clothes and the most comfortable stores, but it's the most expensive place too. After that, I always talk about online shopping. It's the easiest way, since you can compare many shops on your phone. But for me it's the worst option when you need something fast. Finally, the best place is the small shop near my house, because it has good prices and the friendliest people.
texts.trans: Cuando un amigo me pregunta dónde comprar ropa, siempre digo: eso depende. Primero, ¿qué estás buscando? Porque la respuesta es distinta para zapatos y para una chaqueta. Por ejemplo, si quieres ropa barata, las tiendas pequeñas cerca de mi casa tienen los precios más bajos de mi barrio. Pero no tienen la mayor variedad, así que a veces no encuentras tu talla. Luego está el centro comercial. Tiene la ropa más nueva y las tiendas más cómodas, pero también es el lugar más caro. Después, siempre hablo de comprar por internet. Es la forma más fácil, ya que puedes comparar muchas tiendas en el celular. Pero para mí es la peor opción cuando necesitas algo rápido. Finalmente, el mejor lugar es la tienda pequeña cerca de mi casa, porque tiene buenos precios y la gente más amable.

wh.q: Where's the best place to buy clothes in your city?
wh.a: That depends. What are you looking for? For cheap clothes, the small shops near my house have the lowest prices. But the mall has the newest clothes, so it depends on your money.

wh.q: Why don't you always go to the small shops?
wh.a: They don't have the biggest selection, so sometimes I can't find my size. The mall has more clothes, but it's the most expensive place. So I go to the small shops first, and then the mall.

wh.q: What do you think about shopping online?
wh.a: It's the easiest way, since you can compare many shops on your phone. But it's the worst option when you need something fast. So I only buy online when I have time.

wh.q: Which store do you recommend?
wh.a: I recommend the small shop near my house. It has good prices, and the people there are the friendliest. That's why I always go back.

texts.title: U8 · pág 92 - 93
texts.body: I go to Titán Plaza every day, because my shop is very close to it, so I know the mall very well. If you're looking for clothes, take the escalator to the second floor, and the clothing department is in the back. If you want electronics, you don't need the escalator, because it's in the basement, so take the stairs down. The coffee shop is on the ground floor, in the front, near the entrance. For furniture, take the elevator to the third floor, and it's in the back too. It's a big mall, but it's easy to find things once you know the floors. My favorite spot is the coffee shop, since I always stop there before I go back to work. When a friend asks me for directions, I always say the same thing: first, decide what floor you need, and then take the escalator, the stairs, or the elevator.
texts.trans: Voy a Titán Plaza todos los días, porque mi negocio queda muy cerca, así que conozco muy bien el centro comercial. Si buscas ropa, toma la escalera eléctrica al segundo piso, y el departamento de ropa está en la parte de atrás. Si quieres electrónica, no necesitas la escalera eléctrica, porque está en el sótano, así que baja por las escaleras. La cafetería está en el primer piso, al frente, cerca de la entrada. Para muebles, toma el ascensor al tercer piso, y también está en la parte de atrás. Es un centro comercial grande, pero es fácil encontrar las cosas una vez conoces los pisos. Mi lugar favorito es la cafetería, ya que siempre paro ahí antes de volver al trabajo. Cuando un amigo me pide direcciones, siempre digo lo mismo: primero, decide qué piso necesitas, y luego toma la escalera eléctrica, las escaleras, o el ascensor.

wh.q: Where is the clothing department, and how do I get there?
wh.a: Take the escalator to the second floor. The clothing department is in the back, so keep walking after you get off the escalator. It's easy to find once you're on that floor.

wh.q: How do I get to electronics?
wh.a: You don't need the escalator, because electronics is in the basement. So just take the stairs down. It's easy, and you'll see it right away.

wh.q: Where can I get a coffee?
wh.a: The coffee shop is on the ground floor, in the front, near the entrance. You don't need the escalator or the stairs, because it's on the same floor as the entrance. It's a good place to rest before you keep shopping.

wh.q: What's your favorite part of the mall?
wh.a: My favorite spot is the coffee shop, since I always stop there before I go back to work. I go to Titán Plaza every day, so I know it very well. That's why I can give directions easily.
